$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file (see docs/railway-template-metadata.md)

railwayProjectName.description: Optional. Exact Railway workspace project name when it differs from project (overrides fallback matching)

publishedCode.description: Expected public slug after publish (Railway marketplace URL segment)

image.description: HTTPS URL to template image (SVG recommended)

description.description: Short summary for templatePublish (Railway API enforces 25–75 chars)

workspaceAutomation.description: When true, root-repo scripts (publish/verify/sync display names) include this template

logoFile.description: Repo-root logo file named logo-<slug>.png (or .svg), inlined as base64 into template-header.svg. Keep it small (SVG or <=256px PNG); the banner is also the marketplace image

customIcon.description: Built-in fallback icon name used when no logoFile exists (see scripts/lib/template-banner.mjs)

badge.description: shields.io badge used in the shared cross-repo README footer

color.description: Brand color as a 6-digit hex value without a leading #

logo.description: simple-icons slug rendered on the badge (e.g. grafana, influxdb)
